create_sim_driver: create a SimDriver instance that initializes a habitat-sim simulator without a habitat-lab environment
reconfigure_simulator_scene: reconfigure the simulator with a new scene dataset and scene mesh using _reconfigure_sim
reset_environment_state: reset the environment by clearing remote client history and saving a keyframe via _reset_environment
save_gfx_replay_keyframes: save recorded gfx replay keyframes to a gzipped JSON file using _save_recorded_keyframes_to_file
run_sim_update_loop: run the sim_update loop to process app state updates, keyframes, and network client synchronization
